Name: Simple Locked Chests
Author: TechM0nkey
Description:
[size=5][b]Simple Locked Chests[/b][/size]
Private storage for multiplayer farms. Lock your chests, storage furniture and house or shed door so other players can't get into them.

[line]

[size=4][b]Overview[/b][/size]
In co-op, any player can open any chest. This mod adds simple ownership: the first player to open a container becomes its owner, and the owner can set it to Open or Locked. A locked container can only be opened, emptied or picked up by its owner and their spouse.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Lock and unlock chests and Big Chests with a hotkey (F9 by default, configurable)[/*]
[*]Lock storage furniture such as dressers[/*]
[*]Lock your farmhouse, cabin or shed door[/*]
[*]Married players share ownership of everything either spouse owns[/*]
[*]Lock icons on locked storage, with configurable style, size and position[/*]
[*]Hover text showing a container's owner and lock state[/*]
[*]Locked chests are hidden from other players in Chests Anywhere and All Chests Menu[/*]
[*]Optional host override[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu support[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]How ownership works[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Chests and storage furniture:[/b] the first player to open one becomes its owner.[/*]
[*][b]Farmhouse:[/b] owned by the host.[/*]
[*][b]Cabins:[/b] owned by the farmhand who lives there.[/*]
[*][b]Shed and Big Shed:[/b] owned by the first player to lock the door.[/*]
[*][b]Spouses:[/b] married players are full co-owners and can open, lock and unlock each other's property.[/*]
[*][b]Host:[/b] by default the host follows the same rules as everyone else. Turn on HostCanOpenEverything to let the host open any lock.[/*]
[/list]Shop doors, other buildings and gates cannot be locked.

[size=4][b]Usage[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Open a chest or storage furniture once to claim it.[/*]
[*]Face the container or door and press F9.[/*]
[*]Choose Open or Locked.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/518]Chests Anywhere[/url]: chests locked by another player do not appear in the list.[/*]
[*]All Chests Menu: chests locked by another player do not appear in the list.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]: all settings can be changed in game.[/*]
[/list]All players in the game should have the mod installed.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract the download into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game once to create config.json, or use Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]What's new in 2.2.0[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Storage furniture can be locked[/*]
[*]Farmhouse, cabin and shed doors can be locked[/*]
[*]Married players share ownership[/*]
[*]Hover text for owner and lock state[/*]
[*]First player to open a container becomes its owner[/*]
[*]New HostCanOpenEverything option (off by default)[/*]
[*]Locked chests are hidden from other players in Chests Anywhere and All Chests Menu[/*]
[*]Bug fixes and code cleanup[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Source[/b][/size]
Source code is available on [url=https://github.com/TheTechMonkey/simple-locked-chests]GitHub[/url] under the MIT license. Bug reports and suggestions are welcome in the Bugs and Posts tabs.
